title: フィリーズレビューにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Fillies' Revue is here. Today, we'll finally find out if Curren Chan has a chance of winning the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At 1,400 meters, it's a little longer than the distance she's best at, but she faces it with enthusiasm and cuteness.
